method: Flesch-Kincaid estimated age = 0.39 * words / sentence_units + 11.8 * syllables / words - 15.59 + 5. Each punctuated sentence or standalone line is a sentence unit. Same fixed vowel-group heuristic and overrides as the exemplar. These are text estimates, not learner assessments. Staff notes, running headers/footers and document locators are excluded. Pupil page headings, diagram labels, definitions and answer-reveal text are included. File-name stems are counted as alphabetic word groups.

rules: Lowercase; strip possessive apostrophe s and remaining apostrophes.
Subtract final silent e unless consonant-le ending, when count exceeds one.
Subtract final ed except ted or ded, when count exceeds one.

surfaces.label: pupil_page_2
surfaces.text:
Words for charts
chart
A picture that shows data.
category
A group or item being compared.
column
An upright bar in this chart.
axis
A line that helps you read a chart.
scale
The numbered steps along an axis.
comparison
A statement about how two values are alike or different.
A useful comparison
... uses ... points. This is ... points more than ...

surfaces.label: pupil_page_3
surfaces.text:
Knowledge organiser
The aim
I can make a clear chart and use its data to explain a comparison.
Choose a chart
A column chart compares separate items using upright bars. A horizontal bar chart can also work.
Choose the data
Use the item names and their points. Do not plot the whole total as another item.
Make it clear
Use a clear title and labels. Show the unit points. Start the number scale at 0 with equal steps. Avoid 3-D effects.
Check a change
Change one source value and check the matching column. The other columns should stay the same.
My success checks
[ ] I chose the three items and their points.
[ ] I used a clear title, labels and a scale from zero.
[ ] I checked a change, explained a comparison and reopened my file.
Where this leads
Office and stock roles use charts to explain resource needs. A clear chart and a checked comparison can show a digital skill in an application.
